Proposed privacy screen and plant benches for our balcony

FREE-STANDING FURNITURE  ·  NOT FIXED TO THE BUILDING  ·  NO STRUCTURAL WORK

Five free-standing timber benches — items of furniture, the same as an outdoor table or a bookshelf — each with a lattice panel behind it, placed against the inside of the balcony wall. Nothing is fixed, drilled or bolted to the building. This page is for the owners corporation to review and approve.

What's proposed

Five timber modules stand side by side along the inside of the balcony wall. Each is a two-level plant bench with a square-grid lattice panel fixed to its back. The lattice gives privacy above the wall and supports climbing plants; potted plants sit on the benches.

These are items of furniture, not a building structure. Like any other freestanding balcony furniture — a table, a planter, a storage box — they simply rest on the balcony floor under their own weight, and can be lifted out again at any time.
